newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Itau starts as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Itau starts as buy.

text.p: -- Santander Investment said on Wednesday it had started coverage of Brazil's Banco Itau with a buy rating.

-- Analysts Vasco Moreno and Allison Kraver wrote in a report that they expected earnings per share to jump to 48.7, 58.2 and 68.7 reais for 1996, 1997 and 1998, respectively, from a reported 31.5 reais in 1995.
-- "The 12- to 18-month target price of 590 reais implies a 31 percent upside from the current level," they wrote.
-- The company's shares closed at 390 reais on Tuesday in Sao Paulo.
